description: A directed link between two knowledge nodes, or from a node to any other AT Protocol record (a session, a course, another student's note). Stored on the linking user's PDS. Backlinks are derived by the Global View's graph index — no separate backlink record is needed. When a client parses [[wikilink]] syntax in a brain node's markdown, it creates link records for each referenced node.

fromUri.description: AT URI of the source brain node (app.changala.brain.node).

toUri.description: AT URI of the target record. Can be a brain node, a class note, a session, or a course — any AT Protocol record.

label.description: Optional human-readable edge label describing the relationship (e.g. 'expands on', 'contradicts', 'see also', 'source'). Max 64 chars.
